description: List the pinned registry’s components, a page at a time. category, trait and context filter the list (each reply’s availableCategories names the categories); status filters by each component’s HTML-renderer status, not its React or Vue readiness. detail sets each entry’s size: brief (name, categories and one readiness label; the default with no filter), summary (adds tags, contexts, regions and traits) or full (adds the evidence; the default with a filter). page and pageSize walk through totalCount, and hasMore says whether another page follows: up to 200 a page at brief or summary, and up to 10 at full, which is also the page size there when none is given. Use it to choose components, and object_registry for objects. Read-only.

detail.description: Response detail level. Defaults to brief for unfiltered calls (each component's name, categories and one readiness label) and to full when filters are provided. summary adds tags, contexts, regions, traits and status; the evidence behind the readiness label is only in full.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects in registry.objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

status.description: Filter by legacy static-HTML status only: 'stable' = mapped HTML renderer; 'planned' = HTML fallback. Consult productReality.surfaces for React/Vue, generated-consumer and maturity evidence.

name: catalog_list
title: List Components
